set.body: Model terminal demand explicitly and propagate it backward through the pullback program to determine required source support. Cover full fields, target rows or vertices, voxel regions, image slices, masks or ROIs, and time blocks, with exact versus conservative source-support reporting. Acceptance: selections compose predictably; bounds and domain compatibility are validated; demand participates in plan and cache identity; selected evaluation equals selecting the corresponding full result; instrumented sources prove that unneeded target rows and source blocks are not requested when support can be narrowed.
set.title: Spatial demand algebra: ROI, row, slice, vertex, voxel, and time-block planning
